body.purpose: What the last cycle left: a commit to a store no longer has its index built whole, nor its blocks read again. The index is patched by the holons whose version or whose types changed, and gives exactly what a fresh one gives, in the same order, which a test holds it to; a store opened again keeps the blocks already read, as they are named by their hash. Measured before and after: main, 116 thousand holons, 690 thousand facts, about 470 ms to index and 500 to read again.
body.result: A commit of one holon to main: the store read again in about 90 ms where it took 500, its index patched in about 65 where it took 420, exactly as fresh, which tests and a fuzz of 3000 stores hold it to. Git is made fresh, as it gives no order by id. Left: holders and the known map made again for every field, about 130 ms; blocks a host read never let go.
